data.gender_notes: Drusi is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word δρυσος (drusos), which means ‘bear’ or ‘little one’. In the New Testament, Drusus is the name of a Roman nobleman who converted to Christianity. The name Drusi carries the meaning “Bear, little one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Drusi usually hope their child will grow to embody bear, little one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Drusi belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bear, little one.”

in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם דרוסי מקורו בשפה העברית ונגזר מהמילה דרוסה שפירושה עוז וגבור. הוא קשור לנושאים של חוזק ואומץ, ומהווה שם נאה לתינוקות שיהיו חזקים ואמיצים. השם דרוסי משקף את הערכים היהודיים של עוז וגבור.

in_greek.name: Δρούσι
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Δρούσι έχει τις ρίζες του στην ελληνική γλώσσα και σχετίζεται με τη λέξη δύναμη που σημαίνει δύναμη και γενναιότητα. Στην πρώιμη Εκκλησία Χριστιανική, τα ονόματα που είχαν σχέση με την δύναμη και την γενναιότητα ήταν ιδιαίτερα δημοφιλή. Το όνομα Δρούσι αντανακλά τις αξίες της Χριστιανικής παράδοσης.

This narrative reflects the assimilation of various cultures into the Christian faith and the acceptance of diverse backgrounds within the larger Christian community.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, the name Drusus bears a spiritual significance by reflecting the transformative power of the faith in converting individuals regardless of their cultural or social backgrounds. Also, the Drusus in the New Testament exemplifies obedience and submission to the will of God, suggesting divinity's limitless embrace of those who seek salvation.
